g.text: I've decided that you two can split a pizza and fix whatever it is you've got going on. I'd really rather not keep trying to sort this out. Sorry.

g.text: Hey, so... let's try this again.

g.text: PapaPolar: well actually

g.text: MomToxicated: Mmhm.

g.text: PapaPolar: nah, that's fine, lil buddy. wasn't ever your problem to fix.

g.title: j82042236

g.title: j2126655734
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm gonna let minerva answer first lol

g.title: j1953990524
g.text: PapaPolar: another day another höllar

g.title: j4080269662
g.text: MomToxicated: We made this mess, dear. It's our job to decide whether or not we want to clean it up.

g.title: j3952369146
g.text: PapaPolar: well. human-ish, at any rate.

g.title: j1160751611
g.text: PapaPolar: before i let my stupid mouth swallow my whole-ass foot

g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.text: Boolean MinVelApart is now true.

g.title: j3932626911
g.text: MomToxicated: I appreciate your valiant and stalwart efforts, Drifter, but you can feel free to stop.

g.title: j2004818185
g.text: MomToxicated: I have to admit... despite the fact that I... was resistant to it at first?

j517314773
g.text: No, because it's clear you two still care about each other.

g.title: j88903239
g.text: Is that what you want me to do, Minerva?

g.title: j284908710
g.text: MomToxicated: That it went very well.

g.title: j2203181742
g.text: MomToxicated: And what, precisely, gave you that impression?

g.title: j634292015
g.text: MomToxicated: It's clear Velimir isn't over the whole affair.

g.title: j364222878
g.text: Check boolean VelimirBurden

g.title: j301458466
g.text: Something tells me if you both didn't think there was hope, neither of you would never have entertained these conversations from the start.

g.title: j2231165152
g.text: Because you both had that spark for each other once. And if it existed before, it can exist again.

g.title: j401139032
g.text: PapaPolar: mkay. thanks.

g.title: j2545206865
g.text: PapaPolar: i'd gotten into my own head. in a way that wasn't fair to M, sure.

g.title: j364222878->j2545206865
g.text: true

g.title: j312745873
g.text: Check boolean MinervaBurden

g.title: j364222878->j312745873
g.text: false

g.title: j3088317192
g.text: MomToxicated: ... Sigh.

g.title: j382332483
g.text: MomToxicated: Aah, the sweet naïvety of youth.

g.title: j1552132414
g.text: So, you're saying that you are?

g.title: j3733653499
g.text: I wasn't asking Velimir.

g.title: j582424531
g.text: PapaPolar: but also wasn't fair to me.

g.title: j324579754
g.text: MomToxicated: I... had been holding myself to impossible standards. Standards no one was clinging to but me.

g.title: j312745873->j324579754
g.text: true

g.title: j2290505816
g.text: PapaPolar: we were both hurting. and didn't know how to say it. and didn't know how just...stop.

g.title: j312745873->j2290505816
g.text: false

g.title: j2053438049
g.text: You two had something that drew you together. What was it?

g.title: j1376101277
g.text: Tell me a story about the two of you working together.

g.title: j4262413109
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah, hate to tell you lil buddy, sometimes people just effin' change.

g.title: j3055583159
g.text: MomToxicated: No.

g.title: j3643354651
g.text: MomToxicated: And in my focus of ensuring that the nuts and bolts of the relationship were attended to -

g.title: j1778125552
g.text: MomToxicated: All in the name of masking my own fears of inadequacy.

g.title: j1923014371
g.text: MomToxicated: We'd still be stuck in that place, if it weren't for that stupid story of being stuck on that deserted island.

g.title: j1784723451
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir already told you. Alcohol.

g.title: j2013258969
g.text: PapaPolar: oh no, M - they asked for a story - they found my weak point -

g.title: j3007840798
g.text: PapaPolar: sorry.

g.title: j3396063949
g.text: PapaPolar: wait

g.title: j1571229358
g.text: MomToxicated: I missed all the smoke signals that Velimir was sending me, buried within his humor and jokes.

g.title: j2306080891
g.text: PapaPolar: and in my stupid attempts to "cheer her up" i was only driving her farther and farther away

g.title: j2590435214
g.text: PapaPolar: we got laughing about those stupid chickens.

g.title: j646838392
g.text: PapaPolar: well... can't fault you for trying. sorry, lil buddy. think you screwed the pooch on this one

g.title: j472377223
g.text: PapaPolar: agggghhh - bleeding out - aggghhh - red critical hit -

g.title: j3313771505
g.text: PapaPolar: did you just say that you aren't over our marriage or are you saying that you aren't saying that you aren't over it

g.title: j1599821216
g.text: PapaPolar: because i didn't understand that the walls she'd built around her were in self-defense

g.title: j3855627440
g.text: MomToxicated: Those damn chickens! I'll never forget them.

g.title: j1041497596
g.text: MomToxicated: Are you quoting one of Amir's games?

g.title: j2419922981
g.text: PapaPolar: i think i just gave myself a headache

g.title: j2762556090
g.text: PapaPolar: what a time.

g.title: j991003482
g.text: MomToxicated: I knew I shouldn't have left you in the mall unattended. Heh.

g.title: j1159116605
g.text: MomToxicated: The most romantic few weeks of my life, I think.

g.title: j3875618857
g.text: PapaPolar: fading - faading - ability to resist... failing...

g.title: j3589224076
g.text: PapaPolar: same.

g.title: j2764183576
g.text: MomToxicated: Just tell a damn story, you absolute ham.

g.title: j126672026
g.text: Wait. What did the chickens have to do with anything?

g.title: j1856873050
g.text: To each their own... I suppose...

g.title: j2271414738
g.text: O...kay, then.

g.title: j1850893725
g.text: PapaPolar: well now that you said i could. AHERM.

g.title: j231444444
g.text: PapaPolar: hm? oh. nothing.

g.title: j1655016231
g.text: PapaPolar: guess you had to be there.

g.title: j3162551598
g.text: MomToxicated: It's hard to describe.

g.title: j2823120261
g.text: PapaPolar: so no shit, there we were.

g.title: j2647346910
g.text: MomToxicated: But just the two of us? On the island, relying on each other to survive?

g.title: j2096915104
g.text: PapaPolar: flying over the ocean, no land in sight. just the two of us, on this absolutely SHIT puddlejumper we stole

g.title: j1455125735
g.text: MomToxicated: I remember watching him spear fish and thinking to myself... that. That right there.

g.title: j1575248641
g.text: PapaPolar: got it from this drug runner that M slipped some of his own supply to in his "herbal tea" right?

g.title: j2714524230
g.text: MomToxicated: That's the man I'm going to marry.

g.title: j1660118028
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah well turns out drug runners don't make good plane mechanics cuz this thing bursts into flame halfway over open ocean

g.title: j94192828
g.text: MomToxicated: If I don't have to kill him and eat him to survive, of course.

g.title: j561563023
g.text: PapaPolar: whep

g.title: j1010199427
g.text: PapaPolar: awww... you never told me that... :-D

g.title: j299412377
g.text: PapaPolar: we're going down.

g.title: j4238185584
g.text: Very thoughtful.

g.title: j503748428
g.text: ....Right.

g.title: j2909509993
g.text: MomToxicated: He starts screaming.

g.title: j873431703
g.text: PapaPolar: i'd probably eat my arm off before i'd resort to eating your, corpse though.

g.title: j1741725503
g.text: PapaPolar: i start screaming

g.title: j3813483279
g.text: MomToxicated: Oh, hon... be reasonable.

g.title: j1305867256
g.text: PapaPolar: for some reason there are chickens in the back of the plane?

g.title: j4079832244
g.text: PapaPolar: i mean, you're poisonous now, aren't you?

g.title: j2669201331
g.text: PapaPolar: whatever, there are chickens, and they are going NUTS.

g.title: j1093882894
g.text: MomToxicated: Hah! I suppose I am. Yes, that's a good thought. Very quick thinking of you.

g.title: j379736426
g.text: MomToxicated: Which is the least of my concerns while I'm flying a burning plane.

g.title: j2437716201
g.text: Um...

g.title: j2416774608
g.text: Are you two flirting, now?

g.title: j570841652
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah so we crashed

g.title: j109745846
g.text: PapaPolar: i mean, it might be smart to spend time... building up a resistance to your toxin

g.title: j4141960866
g.text: PapaPolar: but luckily minerva here saw a spot of land and we didn't end up drowning, obviously.

g.title: j1235237043
g.text: PapaPolar: in... other ways...

g.title: j2873501186
g.text: PapaPolar: we wound up on this deserted island. maybe 500 feet wide, by a 100 feet long. no fresh water.

g.title: j2877306571
g.text: PapaPolar: you know, just in case we get stranded together again and... worst comes to worst...

g.title: j3512719122
g.text: PapaPolar: palm trees. sand. turquoise water.

g.title: j1776842106
g.text: MomToxicated: You know, now that I'm thinking about it, that would be a very prudent move.

g.title: j3644090614
g.text: MomToxicated: The burning wreckage of our plane.

g.title: j2024299138
g.text: MomToxicated: I should also work on my cold tolerance. Höllavnia is known for its...harsh climates.

g.title: j3323840184
g.text: PapaPolar: eating whatever we could catch. boiling salt water and praying for rain.

g.title: j1273023394
g.text: AaggghhhHH!!

g.title: j3229266056
g.text: I'm gonna just...show myself out.

g.title: j2212435490
g.text: PapaPolar: we nearly starved to death. spent six weeks, surviving alone on that island together.

g.title: j3619576838
g.text: PapaPolar: hahahaha sorry lil buddy, can't help it. it's too funny.

g.title: j3415213482
g.text: MomToxicated: It was the most romantic time of our lives.

g.title: j220472552
g.text: MomToxicated: Ooh Drifter, come on now... lighten up. ;)

g.title: j3828304672
g.text: MomToxicated: And I think the best tan I've ever had.

g.title: j3118509647
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir. What do you say we take this chat offline?

g.title: j2303183608
g.text: PapaPolar: you don't have to ask me twice :-3
